meta.title: List your SaaS for free
meta.description: Submit your SaaS for free: a public page, no review queue, and a dofollow link once your revenue is verified. New products without revenue are welcome.

title: List your SaaS for free
description: The SaaS Harbor welcomes new products from day one. A listing is free, public as soon as you save it, and needs no revenue and no payment details.

dofollow.title: A free dofollow link, earned with verified revenue
dofollow.body: Many directories charge for a followed link to your site. Here it is free: connect your payment provider with a read-only key, and the link from your product page is followed by search engines while your revenue stays verified, even if you hide the figures.

gains.title: What a listing gives
gains.page: A public page for your product with its logo, description, category, tech stack and a link to your website.
gains.lists: A place in New arrivals, Browse and your category and technology pages as soon as you save it.
gains.profile: A profile as the product's founder, where other users can write to you.
gains.views: Page views for your product's page, which only you see.
gains.leaderboard: A place on the leaderboard once you connect your payment provider and share your verified MRR.
gains.badge: A badge for your own site that shows your verified MRR, or that your product is listed.

newSaas.title: Made for new SaaS
newSaas.samePage: Many directories order products by reviews, votes or paid placement, which a new product does not have yet. Here a new product gets the same page as an established one, and appears at the top of New arrivals when it joins.
newSaas.noRevenue: You do not need revenue to list. Once you have it, verifying it through your payment provider puts your product on the leaderboard and makes the link to your website one that search engines follow.

differences.title: How it differs from other directories
differences.free: Free, with no paid plans or upgrades.
differences.noQueue: No review queue: your page is public as soon as you save it.
differences.noPaidPlacements: No paid placements: the leaderboard is ordered by verified MRR, and equal amounts by revenue of all time, then by the date the product was listed.
differences.readOnly: Revenue is read from your payment provider through a read-only key, never typed in.
differences.dofollow: The link to your website is followed by search engines (dofollow) once your revenue is verified, whether you share the figures or not. It is free.
differences.indexing: Search engines hear about your page at once: it joins the sitemap, and Bing and the other search engines that take IndexNow notices are told when you save it.

steps.title: How to list your SaaS
steps.account: Create an account with your email address and a username.
steps.provider: Choose your payment provider at the top of the form. Connect {providers} with a read-only key to verify your MRR, and choose what to share. For any other provider, or none yet, choose Other and write its name.
steps.product: Add your product: name, tagline, description, category, website, launch date, logo and tech stack. It is public when you save it.
steps.extras: If you like, verify your domain with a DNS record and add the badge to your site.

free.question: Is it free to list a SaaS on The SaaS Harbor?
free.answer: Yes. Listing, revenue verification, messages and the badge are free, and there are no paid plans.

noRevenue.question: Can I list a product that has no revenue yet?
noRevenue.answer: Yes. Choose Other as the payment provider and write none. A product without a connected payment provider gets the same public page and appears in Browse, New arrivals and its category and technology pages. Only the leaderboard needs verified MRR.

public.question: How long until my listing is public?
public.answer: It is public as soon as you save it. There is no review queue; admins act on reports afterwards, as the terms describe.

share.question: Do I have to share my revenue?
share.answer: No. Verified revenue, the subscriber count and the launch date are public by default, and you can hide each of them when you add the product or later. Hiding revenue hides MRR too.

providers.question: Which payment providers can verify revenue?
providers.answer: {providers}, one per product, through a key that can only read. Revenue is verified again every hour.

dofollow.question: Is the link to my website dofollow?
dofollow.answer: Yes, and for free, once your revenue is verified, whether you share the figures or not. Without verified revenue the link is marked nofollow.

limits.question: How many products can I list?
limits.answer: Up to {total} per account, and {daily} a day.

remove.question: Can I remove my listing later?
remove.answer: Yes. You can delete a product, or your whole account, at any time, and everything that belongs to it goes with it.
